steps.title: Thaw and recover frozen cells
steps.instruction: Remove each cryovial from liquid nitrogen, immediately submerge in a 37 °C water bath and agitate gently for 1–2 min until ice crystals disappear. Aspirate the cell suspension into a 15 mL centrifuge tube containing 5 mL pre‑warmed complete medium (DMEM + 10 % FBS for HEK‑293FT; RPMI 1640 + 5 % FBS for Jurkat and Raji). Add the cells slowly, then centrifuge at 300 × g for 3 min. Discard the supernatant and gently resuspend the pellet in 5 mL complete medium. Plate the suspension into a 10‑cm dish for HEK‑293FT (bring to a final volume of 10 mL) and into a T25 flask for Jurkat and Raji cells. Place all vessels in a 37 °C incubator with 5 % CO₂.

steps.title: Passage HEK‑293FT adherent cells
steps.instruction: Pre‑warm 0.05 % Trypsin‑EDTA, PBS and DMEM complete medium to 37 °C. Remove old medium from the 10‑cm dish, wash cells once with 3 mL PBS (add slowly along the side wall). Add 2 mL Trypsin‑EDTA, incubate at 37 °C for 1–2 min until cells round. Tap the dish gently to aid detachment, then immediately add 4 mL pre‑warmed complete medium to neutralize the enzyme. Note: keep trypsinization time short; maintain cell density around 3 × 10⁵ cells/mL and concentrate when density falls below 1 × 10⁵ cells/mL.

steps.title: Prepare complete culture media
steps.instruction: Prepare the following media and buffers: • DMEM basic medium for HEK‑293FT: add 10 % FBS (45 mL per 500 mL) and 1 × 5 mL Penicillin/Streptomycin (100×) to 500 mL; store at 4 °C ≤3 weeks. • RPMI‑1640 basic medium for Jurkat and Raji: add 5 % FBS (25 mL per 500 mL) and 1 × 5 mL Penicillin/Streptomycin (100×) to 500 mL; store at 4 °C ≤3 weeks. • MACS buffer for cell sorting: PBS with 2 % FBS (48.8 mL per 50 mL) and 2 mM EDTA (0.2 mL of 0.5 M, pH 8.0); filter through a 0.2‑µm filter and store at 4 °C ≤3 weeks.

steps.title: Seed HEK‑293FT for virus production
steps.instruction: At least 18–24 h before transfection, ensure HEK‑293FT cells have undergone ≥3 passages after thawing, show >90 % viability and are in logarithmic growth. Detach and resuspend cells in 5 mL antibiotic‑free DMEM to obtain a single‑cell suspension (avoid bubbles). Count viable cells with a Vi‑CELL BLU Analyzer and plate 7 × 10⁵ cells per well in a 6‑well plate using 2 mL medium per well. Mix gently by rocking the plate back‑and‑forth; avoid rotating the plate. Incubate at 37 °C with 5 % CO₂.

steps.title: Transfect HEK‑293FT with lentiviral plasmids
steps.instruction: When cells reach 70‑80 % confluence (18–24 h post‑seeding), prepare the DNA‑lipid mix: add 1.05 µg total plasmid DNA to 250 µL pre‑warmed Opti‑MEM in a 1.5 mL EP tube, vortex, then add 3 µL Hieff Trans liposomal reagent (3:1 liposomal:DNA ratio) and flick gently. Incubate 20 min at room temperature. Drop the mixture onto the cells, swirl the plate gently, and incubate 6–8 h at 37 °C. Remove the transfection supernatant and slowly add 2 mL DMEM supplemented with 10 % FBS and 1 % Pen/Strep along the side wall. Return plates to a 37 °C, 5 % CO₂ incubator.

steps.title: Collect and store lentiviral supernatant
steps.instruction: Harvest supernatant 48 h post‑transfection and keep at 4 °C in 15 mL centrifuge tubes. Add 2 mL complete medium to the cells and incubate an additional 24 h (72 h total). Combine this second harvest with the first, filter the pooled supernatant through a 0.45 µm filter, aliquot into sterile tubes and store at –80 °C (short‑term storage at 4 °C is acceptable for hours to days).

steps.title: Determine lentiviral titer by flow cytometry
steps.instruction: Adjust Jurkat cells to 1 × 10⁶ cells/mL. Dispense 100 µL into each of six wells of a 48‑well plate. Add 0, 12.5, 25, 50, 100 and 200 µL of viral stock to the respective wells, then add RPMI medium to a final volume of 400 µL. Incubate ≥72 h at 37 °C, 5 % CO₂. For analysis, transfer 200 µL of each culture to a 96‑well plate, centrifuge 300 g for 3 min and discard supernatant. Resuspend cells in 50 µL PBS containing Zombie Violet dye (1:500 dilution), incubate 20 min in the dark at 4 °C. Add two volumes of cell‑staining buffer, centrifuge 300 g for 3 min, discard supernatant, wash twice with 200 µL staining buffer, and finally resuspend in 300 µL staining buffer for acquisition on an LSRFortessa X20. Calculate infectious units per mL using: (cells per well × % GFP⁺ cells) × 1000 / (µL virus added). Keep infection ≤15 % to ensure single‑integration events.
